scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist');"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test:all: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:registry && npm run test:engine
scripts.release: npm run test:all && npm run build:standalone
